svg.title: Knowledge ingestion: prepare, publish, clean up
svg.desc: Only a published revision becomes current for retrieval. Cleanup failure can leave cleanupPending for repair. Removal revokes visibility before cleanup. Retrieval must check the published revision rather than trusting any old chunk still in the vector store.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
